verdict.rationale: The only notification-like evidence is the Slack integration, which sends task artifact updates into team channels. The remote-daemon tutorial also shows you can control tasks from a phone via app.humanlayer.com, which implies some remote awareness. Nothing explicitly says HumanLayer alerts the developer when an agent finishes a task or is blocked waiting for input. Missing for 10: explicit completion notifications, explicit needs-input or approval alerts, documented notification channels and settings (push, email, desktop), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
